title: Fusion Summon L4-2
source: Port-authored setup from Tools/puzzles/generate_puzzles.py template 'fusion_summon', level 4, variant 2. The line uses engine-supported cards but is not a GBA fixed-board reconstruction.
notes: Fusion Summon Elemental Hero Flame Wingman with Miracle Fusion, then attack for exactly 5100.

canon_reference.setup_status: canon setup unavailable; this file uses a port-authored template
solution_steps: Get rid of Jinzo by returning him to the top of your opponents deck with Back to Square One. Use Total Defense Shogun as discard cost.
Activate The Shallow Grave and have your Shogun return. Your opponent will pick Penumbral Soldier Lady.
Activate Ceasefire for 1500 damage. Shogun and Soldier lady will now be face-up.
Have Shogun destroy the Soldier Lady by battle (he can attack in defense mode) - Fatal Abacus will add in some extra damage.
